sims.title: Band Score Calculator
sims.caption: Drag each criterion band to see how the mean rounds to your overall Writing band.

sims.title: Conditional Tense Patterns
sims.caption: Toggle between zero, first, and second conditionals to see how the tense shift signals epistemic distance.

sims.title: Article Decision Trainer
sims.caption: Step through the three-question decision flow for each noun phrase and pick the right article.

sims.title: Punctuation For Complex Sentences
sims.caption: Cycle through punctuation variants for each sentence and see whether the result is correct or a named error.

sims.title: Question-Type Classifier Drill
sims.caption: Read each prompt, choose the question type, then reveal the signal phrase that tells you.

sims.title: Idea Extension Chain
sims.caption: Step through the domino chain — see where Band 6 stops and where Band 7 keeps going.

sims.title: Linker Density Sweet Spot
sims.caption: Slide the linker count from 0 to 6 and watch the paragraph change — too few leaves ideas unconnected; too many reads as mechanical padding.

sims.title: Collocation Synonym Picker
sims.caption: Choose a frame, then tap a synonym to see whether it collocates naturally. Notice how thesaurus alternatives split into safe and unsafe.

sims.title: Theme Vocabulary Quiz
sims.caption: Choose a theme, then complete each collocation — covers all eight high-frequency IELTS topics.

sims.title: Trend Language Matcher
sims.caption: Pick a chart shape — the matching verbs, adverbs, and noun forms light up. Intensity must match slope.

sims.title: Key Features: Line, Bar & Table
sims.caption: Toggle between chart types. Click "Highlight key features" to see which data points to select — and why the others can be safely omitted.

sims.title: Pie Proportion Language
sims.caption: Click a slice to see how to describe its share using Band 7 proportion phrases — not "the percentage of X is …".

sims.title: Mixed Charts — Link Sentence Builder
sims.caption: See how a line graph and a pie chart share one overview. Click "Reveal link sentence" to see the Band 7 move that connects the two visuals.

sims.concept: Data Accuracy And No Opinion Rule
sims.title: Approximation Language Trainer
sims.caption: Drag the bar to any value. See when to hedge ("approximately 35%") vs. when to be precise ("exactly 25%") — and why adding a reason always breaks the No Opinion Rule.

sims.title: 60-Minute Exam Timing Planner
sims.caption: Allocate plan / write / check minutes across both tasks and see whether your split honours the 2/3 rule and word-count pace.

sims.title: Band 6 → Band 7 Upgrade Walkthrough
sims.caption: Step through each upgrade move — Fix error first, then Combine, then Collocate — and see exactly what changes at each stage.
